schema.description: Knowledge graph for Introduction to Numerical Analysis

node_fields.name: node name
node_fields.visual: interactive | simulation | algorithm | function | chart | diagram | none (optional; absent = none)
node_fields.visual_hint: one-line description of what to show/manipulate; required when visual is set and != none

nodes.name: Euler's Method, Runge-Kutta Methods, and Stability of ODE Methods
nodes.name_zh: 欧拉法、Runge-Kutta 法与ODE 稳定性

nodes.name: Floating Point Representation
nodes.description: Finite-precision IEEE 754 representation of reals, introducing machine epsilon and rounding error that limit the accuracy of numerical computation.

nodes.name: Error Analysis
nodes.description: Quantifying computational error through forward and backward error and assessing an algorithm's stability under rounding and perturbations.

nodes.name: Conditioning
nodes.description: The condition number measuring how sensitively a problem's output responds to input perturbations, independent of the algorithm used.

nodes.name: Bisection Method
nodes.description: A robust root-finding method repeatedly halving a bracketing interval where the function changes sign, converging linearly to a root.
nodes.visual_hint: Halve a bracketing interval each step converging on a root.

nodes.name: Newton's Method
nodes.description: An iterative root-finding method using the function and its derivative, converging quadratically near simple roots from a good initial guess.
nodes.visual_hint: Step Newton's method following tangents to a root.

nodes.name: Secant Method
nodes.description: A derivative-free root-finding method approximating Newton's slope with a finite difference of recent iterates, converging superlinearly.
nodes.visual_hint: Step the secant method using a chord to approach a root.

nodes.name: LU Factorization
nodes.description: Factoring a matrix into lower and upper triangular factors via Gaussian elimination, enabling efficient repeated solution of linear systems.

nodes.name: Cholesky Factorization
nodes.description: A specialised factorisation of symmetric positive-definite matrices into a lower triangular factor times its transpose, faster than general LU.

nodes.name: Iterative Methods
nodes.description: Iterative solvers such as Jacobi and Gauss-Seidel that refine an approximate solution to a linear system, suited to large sparse matrices.

nodes.name: Polynomial Interpolation
nodes.description: Constructing a polynomial passing through given data points, expressed in Lagrange or Newton form, to approximate functions between samples.
nodes.visual_hint: Fit an interpolating polynomial through given data points.

nodes.name: Spline Interpolation
nodes.description: Piecewise low-degree polynomials joined smoothly at knots, avoiding the oscillation of high-degree interpolation while fitting data.
nodes.visual_hint: Fit a smooth piecewise spline through knots without oscillation.

nodes.name: Least Squares Approximation
nodes.description: Fitting overdetermined systems by minimising squared residuals, solved through the normal equations or orthogonal factorisations.
nodes.visual_hint: Fit a least-squares line minimising the squared residuals.

nodes.name: Newton-Cotes Formulas
nodes.description: Numerical integration rules such as the trapezoidal and Simpson's rules that approximate integrals using equally spaced sample points.
nodes.visual_hint: Approximate an integral with trapezoidal and Simpson's-rule strips.

nodes.name: Gaussian Quadrature
nodes.description: Numerical integration choosing optimal nodes and weights to integrate polynomials of the highest possible degree exactly.

nodes.name: Euler's Method
nodes.description: The simplest numerical method for ODEs, stepping forward (explicit) or backward (implicit) using the slope to advance the solution.
nodes.visual_hint: Step Euler's method along a slope field approximating an ODE solution.

nodes.name: Runge-Kutta Methods
nodes.description: A family of higher-order explicit ODE methods, notably RK4, combining several slope evaluations per step for greater accuracy.
nodes.visual_hint: Compare RK4 against Euler approximating an ODE solution.

nodes.name: Stability of ODE Methods
nodes.description: Stability of ODE solvers, including A-stability and the difficulty stiff equations pose, which constrains the usable step size.
